dedupe_keys.name: idecv cabo verde national roads airports ports hydraulic infrastructure and hazard maps ingt geoserver

description: The spatial data infrastructure of Cabo Verde (IDECV), run by the Instituto Nacional de Gestão do Território (INGT), publishes national layers through a GeoNetwork metadata catalogue (about 50 records), a Lizmap viewer and a GeoServer with WMS and WFS services. Contents: infrastructure layers for national roads (estradas nacionais, classified into first, second and third class by the places they connect, supplied by Infraestruturas de Cabo Verde), airports, ports, hydraulic infrastructure, schools and airport servitudes; hazard and susceptibility maps from the 2012 to 2016 risk reduction project (floods, volcanic and seismic hazard, slope movements, drought, forest fires, coastal and beach erosion); and reference layers for islands, municipalities, parishes, places, hydrographic basins, geology, agriculture, geodetic network and maritime zones, plus municipal plan layers (road network, technical networks). Coverage: all islands of Cabo Verde (hazard maps exclude Santa Luzia and islets); the roads record dates from 2023 to 2024. Format and access: WFS (GeoJSON, GML, Shapefile output) and WMS from geoservicos-ingt.gov.cv, metadata on metadados-ingt.gov.cv. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, as stated in the metadata; free. Caveats: attributes were not inspected, and the hazard maps date from 2014. Simulation uses: road, port and airport networks with hazard layers for hazard exposure and resilience studies of a small island state. Related records: ARME's electronic communications indicators (data-arme-cabo-verde-electronic-communications-statistical-indicators) cover telecom.
